title: Supply, Installation, Testing and Commissioning of IoT-based Ultrasonic-type Digital water meters Confirming to ISO:4064-2014 for water supply lines to the additional Buildings at IIT Hyderabad, Kandi, Sangareddy
scope_summary: Tender for the supply, installation, testing, and commissioning of IoT-based ultrasonic digital water meters for water supply lines in additional buildings at IIT Hyderabad. The meters must conform to ISO:4064-2014 and include data logging, transmission, storage, and predictive maintenance capabilities.

title: Expression of Interest (EOI) for Implementation of Asset Performance Management System in OPTCL
scope_summary: An Expression of Interest for the implementation of an Asset Performance Management (APM) system in Odisha Power Transmission Corporation Limited (OPTCL). The tender aims to invite qualified agencies to provide an APM solution to enhance operational efficiency and asset reliability.
